rule: Each blocker is classified by its actual cause; a country is published only when every cause is resolved through the existing gates. Causes: reuse_restriction (terms restrict or are absent), missing_official_evidence (official file, rule text, vintage or terms not located or not reviewable), parser_incompatibility (format not handled), identity_unverified (list, alliance or party identity not documented officially), internal_approval (owner authorisation still required).

germany_2025_metadata.finding: The 2025 electoral-system record holds the threshold, three-constituency exception, minority exemption and fixed 630-seat rule in its sourced, published 'notes' field (provenance src-de-bwl-system-2025 and src-de-bwl-system-size), while the structured national_rules fields are absent. The details panel reported those empty structured fields as 'not established'.
germany_2025_metadata.resolution: Presentation only: empty structured fields now say they are not recorded as separate structured fields and show the sourced system description with its source IDs. No German store is changed and no value is parsed into a structured field.

datastat_and_catalogue_findings: VOLPS202503, VOLPS202502 and VOLPS202504 (admitted rights evidence for VOLPS202503 only) carry a list dimension coded to the 2025 lists (VSTRANAPS2025); for 1996–2021 they contain national totals only (valid votes; 200 seats), no list rows.

VOLPS ('Volby do Poslanecké sněmovny', version 3, data updated 2026-07-01) has dimensions indicators × years × territory and no list dimension: aggregates only. Its distributions carry the same no-protected-rights metadata, but it is a separate distribution and was not admitted.

2021: the national catalogue lists polling-station party votes ('okrsková data, počty hlasů pro strany', distribution https://www.volby.cz/opendata/ps2021/csv_od/pst4p_csv_od.zip, no-protected-rights metadata), polling-station voters and votes, the list register (číselník volebních stran) and list composition (složení volebních stran). No catalogue dataset contains seats by list for 2021; national list votes would be an Atlas aggregation of polling-station rows.
2002–2017: no catalogue dataset with list-level results or seats was found; the list-level files exist only on the volby.gov.cz open-data pages (Production 1B route).
exact_obstacles: Seats by list (2002–2021) exist only in volby.gov.cz files, whose reuse gate awaits ČSÚ's written reply (owner decision 2026-10-25); the 2025 DataStat decision is not extended to them.

2021 list votes are available only at polling-station level from separate distributions on an unregistered host (www.volby.cz); admitting them needs its own owner rights decision, manual staging and an aggregation rule, and would still lack seats.
No historical party-series relationship can be established without at least two admitted elections and the official list-composition registers.
czechia_historical_review.unblock: Owner sends the ČSÚ contact packet; with a reply confirming reuse of the volby.gov.cz open-data files, the existing staging builder (scripts/political-data/czechia/build-candidate.mjs) and the Production 1B gates can admit 2002–2021, and the CVS composition registers can document coalition membership.
czechia_historical_review.correction_2026_11_02: This review was wrong for 2017 and 2021. Its catalogue searches were too narrow: ČSÚ publishes VOLPS201703 and VOLPS202103 (votes and seats by list) with the same rights metadata as VOLPS202503. Both elections are now admitted. The statements below about 2021 seats and 2017 list-level data are superseded; 2002–2013 were still not found in list-level form.

czech_identity_blocker.finding: ČSÚ's list register CVS states it covers electoral parties from all elections since 1998 and enables comparison over time ('Umožňuje tak časové srovnání'), with a list kind (TYPVS) and composition. Linking ballot numbers to register codes needs psrkl. All of these files are on volby.gov.cz, registered with automation not permitted, and the owner chose to stage files from that host.
